parameters.content:
## Intake Form
intake.html submissions:
1. AUTO-CREATE the client portal (clients upsert by slug +
   login invitation for the submitter email) — appears in the
   admin panel immediately. Nothing is sent to the client.
2. Voice notes are transcribed (Whisper) and summarized into
   bullets (gpt-4o-mini) so the team can skim; audio stays
   attached. Both AI steps fail-soft — email still sends.
3. Email the team the full submission.

To deliver the portal to the client: email
ai@think-technologies.com 'send portal <company>' —
handled by 'Think Portal — Send Portal On Request'
(activate once hosting is live).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ slug: $json.slug, name: $json.company, domain: $json.domain || null, logo_url: $json.logo_url, logo_on_light: true }) }}

parameters.subject: =New intake [{{ $json.industry || 'no industry' }}] — {{ $json.company }} (voice note)
parameters.message:
={{ 'New client intake submission:

Name: ' + $json.name + '
Company email: ' + $json.email + '
Teammates to keep updated: ' + ($json.teamEmails || '—') + '

Company: ' + $json.company + '
Website: ' + ($json.site || '—') + '
Social media: ' + ($json.social || '—') + '
Industry: ' + $json.industry + '

=== MAIN PAIN POINT ===
' + '
🎤 Voice note summary (' + $json.audioSeconds + 's, AI-generated):
' + $json.summary + ($json.transcript ? '

Full transcript:
' + $json.transcript : '') + ($json.painPoint ? '

Also typed:
' + $json.painPoint : '') + '

(Audio attached — AI summary/transcript may miss nuance, listen if in doubt.)' + '

PORTAL AUTO-CREATED (not sent to the client):
- It now appears in the admin panel under ' + $json.company + '
- Portal link: https://portal.think-technologies.com/index.html?client=' + $json.slug + '
- Next: link their Google Drive folder in the admin panel, then email ai@think-technologies.com with subject: send portal ' + $json.company }}
